column1: # Base image build manifest. Consumed by build-images.sh.
# type: cloud        -> download official cloud qcow2 + virt-customize (FULLY AUTOMATED)
#       opnsense-img -> download OPNsense serial .img.bz2 + convert (AUTOMATED, no installer)
#       iso-install  -> create blank disk + boot ISO installer (ASSISTED; you supply ISO)
# For iso-install rows the 'source' column names the ENV VAR that must hold the ISO path.
